title: Taxi minimum city fare
content: Taxi minimum city fare Transport 250 XAF MINTOUL states the minimum city taxi price is 250 FCFA; actual fare varies with distance.

title: Typical individual city taxi course
content: Typical individual city taxi course Transport about 2,000 XAF MINTOUL says an individual city trip is generally around 2,000 FCFA, with price to be negotiated.

title: Airport taxi daytime
content: Airport taxi daytime Transport 3,500 XAF MINTOUL states an airport trip costs 3,500 FCFA in daytime.

title: Airport taxi night
content: Airport taxi night Transport 5,000 XAF MINTOUL states an airport trip costs 5,000 FCFA at night after 18:00.

title: Road toll
content: Road toll Transport 500 XAF per vehicle per toll station MINTOUL states a road toll of 500 FCFA per vehicle and station.

title: International airports
content: International airports Air transport Yaoundé, Douala, Garoua MINTOUL states Cameroon has three international airports: Yaoundé, Douala and Garoua.

title: Rail corridor
content: Rail corridor Rail transport Douala–Yaoundé–Ngaoundéré MINTOUL describes the Transcamerounais railway as connecting Douala to Ngaoundéré through Yaoundé.

title: Tourist visa validity

content: Tourist visa amount Entry 50,000 XAF (according to MINTOUL page) MINTOUL gives 50,000 FCFA according to exchange rate; treat as indicative and verify before advising users.
